brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3x hex-acc-keyhole on rear face slots 4 of pieces -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0; provides lift-and-drop mounting on wall screws

7x hex-acc-hook plates (2 hooks per plate = 14 hooks) on front faces: slots 1 and 2 on all three cells plus slot 5 on -1,0,0. Configurator allows hanging cable-coil / tape-gaffer props on these hooks when elevated - at bench level they report PROP_NO_REST (would hang through bench)

finish.summary: Built 3-cell horizontal rack (-1,0,0 to 1,0,0) with 3 keyhole hangers on back for wall mounting and 7 hook plates (14 hooks) on front for small hand tools. Joints locked and caps applied. Prop hanging verified conceptually but props require elevated mounting to avoid bench collision.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
